correctness.rationale: An exact factorization of the second iterate minus the identity gives the complete primitive two-cycle census on the stated invariant parameter interval. The two-cycle multiplier follows by the symmetric functions of its roots, and is strictly decreasing to a single -1 crossing at the stated nested-radical expression. A negative explicit Schwarzian and strictly transverse multiplier ensure a positive cubic flip coefficient at both fixed points of the second iterate. An analytic expansion of the fourth iterate minus the identity near a moving two-cycle point proves the locally unique new four-cycle on the right, no nearby four-cycle on the left, exact square-root amplitudes, and a multiplier with the displayed leading asymptotic coefficient. The bundled checker separately verifies critical algebra and finite high-precision instances; finite calculations are not used to prove the infinite claims.

value.rationale: The second period-doubling and local creation of a four-cycle are explicit phenomena reported only numerically for a natural published rational interval family. The closed-form threshold determines an exact parameter boundary, the global two-cycle census gives the entire attracting/repelling phase, and the two distinct critical amplitudes and leading four-cycle multiplier quantify the previously unresolved onset of period four. These are motivated natural dynamical invariants and not arbitrary parameter slicing or a bare decimal refinement. The classical generic flip method is not presented as novel.
